english.note: Use this fuller phrase when explicitly stressing that an outcome is possible, especially before a clause.

exampleSentences.english: If it rains heavily again, the road could potentially flood.
exampleSentences.traditional: 如果再落大雨，條路有可能會水浸。
exampleSentences.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 zoi3 lok6 daai6 jyu5 tiu4 lou6 jau5 ho2 nang4 wui5 seoi2 zam3

english.note: Use this when you want to stress that something is possible, rather than giving only a bare neutral “maybe.”

exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個計劃有可能成功㗎。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei1 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 ho2 nang4 sing4 gung1 gaa3

english.note: Use this when focusing on whether an action is feasible or has a chance of succeeding.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 ho2 nang4 sing4 gung1
